2604.26969 AgenticRecTune (Δ5): final 40.0 (= son55). M → son55 2 (skill evolution reduces to appending domain knowledge, opus:O04; no argument against BO/bandit tuners). RS → sol (adapt_via_conditioning only; the A/B platform is an evaluator, not a sound solver, and son55 itself calls the split 'a role split of LLM prompts'). G → son55 3; E.causality → sol 2 (clean store-off of the orchestrator skills, but no hand-written or non-feedback decomposition-skill arm and no budget-matched baseline; r11b EvoSkill / r15a CoEvoSkills convention); E.statistics → sol 1 (A2: Avg@4/Max@4 from one skill-learning run, r15a SkillX precedent). M → son55 1. claim_support → sol 'unsupported' (r03b AgentRR / r11b AutoSkill precedent). evidence_level: son55 wrote 'none'; normalised to canonical null with evidence_level_note (recorded in shared_error_corrections as a normalisation, not a mechanical conflict because rv2 reads 'none' as null).
